plan.title: Module 8: Session Start and Authorized Work Selection

narratives.Description: Deliver Module 8 as a self-directed lesson using sanitized fictional state snapshots rather than a learner's live GitHub repository, cache, or confidential backlog. This story is independently buildable because it owns the posture and work-selection decision exercise, explained solution, source trace, navigation, and focused content verification while leaving implementation, gates, and review to Modules 9 through 11.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Revalidate the pinned Directive 0.112.0 session, ordered-plan, ranked-queue, cache, and audit-log surfaces and record any live-runtime versus deposited-prose drift in the source notes.
2. Author curriculum/modules/08-session-and-work-selection.md and solutions/module-08-session-and-work-selection.md with fixed fictional request cards, state snapshots, a deterministic decision matrix, progressive hints, and outcome-mapped evidence.
3. Update the exact navigation and reference files, add scripts/verify-module-8.mjs plus negative unit tests, and run the focused npm checks and xBRIEF conformance check before the aggregate gate.
narratives.UserStory: As a 3Ci engineer learning Directive, I want to classify session posture and choose work from authoritative selection surfaces, so that I can resume safely without treating caches, plans, or completed scopes as implementation authority.
narratives.Traces: Parent training.modules6-8.sessions, PROJECT-DEFINITION LearningGoals: session start and ordered work selection, PROJECT-DEFINITION SourceOfTruth, DirectiveBaseline, LabModel, and NonGoals contracts

narrative.Acceptance: The source record validates exact Directive 0.112.0 session and work-selection behavior and records every disagreement between deposited prose and the released command surface.

items.title: Teach session posture and recovery decisions

narrative.Acceptance: Given sanitized request cards and fixed state snapshots, the learner records the correct read-only or mutation posture, start or recovery route, and any missing authority for each case.
When an active ordered plan exists, the exercise rejects adjacent ranked-queue work; when that plan is exhausted, it stops until an explicit queue selection or operator target exists.

The exercise records the learner's mapping of ordered plan, ranked cache, pending scope, audit log, active scope, and live intent to exact roles without reading a live backlog or treating any record alone as implementation authority.

items.title: Add the explained solution and focused verifier

narrative.Acceptance: Negative tests reject incorrect outcome mappings, canonical state paths, local links, exact Directive 0.112.0 claims, and Module 9's still-planned status; the explained solution records the expected evidence.

expected_outputs: Module 8 lesson and solution satisfy the self-directed content contract using fixed fictional state
Negative verifier tests reject incorrect posture, queue precedence, state roles, links, and version claims
No learner step requires a live GitHub backlog, Directive cache, or confidential project state
